rationale: CodeQL js/xss-through-dom at AttachmentImagePreview.tsx:200. The SARIF flow starts at the Jira 'Import target' select value, which jiraTargetFromValue parsed straight into a step localId used as an attachment map key. selectJiraImportTarget now resolves the parsed target back to a live step through resolveJiraImportTarget, so the bound localId comes from the steps state, not from DOM text. The sink is also guarded: isSafeAttachmentPreviewUrl restricts the img src and the lightbox download link to relative, blob:, http(s) and image/* data: sources.

The step file picker called updateStepAttachments directly, so overriding the browser accept filter bypassed the policy content-type check the identical drop applies. handleStepAttachmentDrop is now the single entry point addStepAttachmentFiles, used by both the drop handler and the picker onChange; new test 'rejects picker selections the attachment policy does not allow' pins the parity.

The primary-step context list mapped only persistedObjectiveAttachments, so a Jira image imported into the objective target had no chip or thumbnail until it was persisted. Pending selectedObjectiveAttachmentFiles are now included for the primary step with removeObjectiveAttachment removal (which also refreshes preset reapply state) and the same retry affordance as step files. Covered by 'previews a pending objective image imported from Jira in the primary step'.

InputImagesSection in workflow-detail.tsx now renders AttachmentImagePreview instead of the parallel static .queue-attachment-preview image, so the clickable thumbnail/lightbox behaviour is the same wherever attachments are listed. The now-unused .queue-attachment-preview CSS rule was deleted and the detail test asserts the shared thumbnail, its lightbox and the unavailable fallback.

The lightbox now traps Tab. The first/last focus loop that DashboardActionDialog carried inline was extracted to frontend/src/lib/focusTrap.ts (FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR, focusableElementsWithin, trapTabWithin); both modals use it, so the behaviour is defined once. New test 'keeps Tab inside the open lightbox'.

AttachmentImagePreview now handles onError on both the thumbnail and the lightbox image: it suppresses itself (so the :has(.attachment-thumbnail) rule stops hiding the generic icon and the chip keeps its metadata/download action), closes any open lightbox, and reports through the new onPreviewError prop, which workflow-detail uses to render its explicit unavailable state. Covered by two new component tests.
